name: Tweenies
description: Tweenies Bella, Milo, Fizz and Jake get into many adventures such as visiting a farm, watching puppet shows, learning new songs and listening to stories.

videos.title: Night-Time Magic
videos.overview: Eddie the Dream Genie shows the Tweenies that there's no need to be scared of the dark.

videos.title: Jungle Adventure
videos.overview: The Tweenies are determined to help their new animal friends, and guided by fun-loving Eddy they unravel the mysteries and strive to bring the jingle back to the jungle.

videos.title: Ready to Play
videos.overview: Learn all about the Tweenies in their first video release ever! (Clip show)

videos.title: Song Time!
videos.overview: Join the Tweenies - Bella, Fizz, Milo, and Jake - as they sing a mix of songs old and new. (Clip show)

videos.title: Song Time! 2
videos.overview: Another musical extravaganza with the Tweenies. (Clip show)

videos.title: Animal Friends
videos.overview: Bella, Milo, Fizz and Jake are back, and they want to find out all about animals. Included are a trip to the farm to see a cow being milked, a song about a starfish, a finger puppet show, a story about lions and mice, and an encounter with a dragon who can't breathe fire. (Clip show)

videos.title: Party Games, Laughs and Giggles
videos.overview: Are you ready to play games, have some giggles and have a party with the Tweenies? (Clip show)

videos.title: Merry Tweenie Christmas
videos.overview: Join the Tweenies for some fab-a-rooney festive fun! Compilation of five episodes from the first series.

videos.title: Music is Pop-a-rooney (Tweenies Top of the Pops)
videos.overview: Join Bella, Milo, Fizz, and Jake as they fulfill their dreams and perform in front of a Top of the Pops audience. They each have their favourite pop-a-rooney tunes they are eager to play, and they each speak about the secrets of their success when Judy comes to interview them.

videos.title: Song Time is Fab-a-rooney!
videos.overview: The Tweenies enjoy a third song-filled spectacular, in which they sing along 25 brilliant tunes. (Clip show)

videos.title: Colours are Magic!
videos.overview: The Tweenies have some fun learning about rainbows. Dotman rescues all the colours from the garden. The Tweenies mix colours to make new ones for their dice for their game. (Clip show)

videos.title: Tweenies Live!
videos.overview: Join Bella, Milo, Fizz and Jake as they take centre stage in their very first live show! It was filmed at London Arena! Use your imagination!

videos.title: Songs and Surprises
videos.overview: More fun-packed capers with the colourful children's television characters. The Tweenies indulge in some practical jokes, play at being pirates, dress up as Goldilocks and even manage to go car racing. Finally a game of make-believe wizards ends in surprise all round, as Milo and Jake make Doodles disappear... (Clip show)

videos.title: Enchanted Toyshop
videos.overview: Join the BBC's "fab-a-rooney" foursome in their 95-minute fun-packed Christmas video Tweenies--Enchanted Toyshop. The toyshop is a magical dolls house which links the five episodes. The Tweenies individually enter the shop via their imagination. They shrink and then see the toy of their dreams come alive. Fizz befriends and sings with Penny the Pop Princess, Jake helps Jangles the Clown have faith in himself, Milo meets a true hero in The Little Blue Plane and Bella's aspirations are realised when she directs and stars alongside thespian mice in a theatre. The final episode goes inside the shop once more as Father Christmas wraps these very special presents on Christmas Eve.

videos.title: Everybody Panto
videos.overview: There are lots of fantastic things to do when the Tweenies decide to put on their very own pantomime! Join in the fun when the Tweenies make invitations and decorate the playroom. Milo finds out about snow and Fizz makes some very funny wishes with Doodles' wishbone. The excitement builds as the Tweenies get ready to perform...

videos.title: Tweenies Live - The Christmas Present
videos.overview: Bella, Milo, Fizz and Jake return for some more fun-filled antics and this time there's a festive feeling in the air.

videos.title: It's Messy Time!
videos.overview: Join Bella, Milo, Fizz and Jake for some more fun-filled antics. This time they're playing with magnets, having their own sports day, making puppets and putting on a play. (Clip show)

videos.title: Let's Play
videos.overview: Hey, hey are you ready to play? Then join the Tweenies as they sing, dance, laugh and play! Can you find the hidden Tweenies before Bella does? See what happens when Fizz rescues the giant snake from Milo. Sing songs and play games as Bella, Milo and Fizz teach Jake about pushing and pulling. Judy’s bananas have gone missing! The Tweenies are playing tricks and monkeying about – you can be a cheeky monkey too! Doodles, Izzles and the Tweenies are putting on a show. When Jake wants to dance like his friends, he practices hard and soon all the Tweenies are performing their favourite dances together. (Clip show)

videos.title: Let's All Make Music
videos.overview: Do you like to make music? Well the Tweenies love to! In each of these four fantastic episodes they explore a different section of the orchestra. First they learn all about percussion instruments which are Milo’s favourite, he becomes a one-man band and plays them all together! Then they find out about the strings which Fizz loves, and have great fun acting out Old King Cole. Next it’s the turn of the brass section, and Bella dreams of leading the others in a cool brass band. Finally Jake is wild about woodwind and in this episode the Tweenies take turns playing the recorder and Judy’s flute. The DVD also features a bonus episode in which Max plays the drums in a very talented school orchestra.

videos.overview: Milo makes Fizz mad due to him messing up her stuff. Then she hides with her toy dinosaur. When The Tweenies find her, Milo apologizes and asks's what is that dinosaur? Jake then asks if it's real.

videos.title: Spider
videos.overview: Bella surprizes the Tweenies with a cool pirvate costume, And the Tweenies find a map and pretends there on a treasure hunt.

videos.overview: Song:I Wish i could fly   About:Doodles is Stuck way up high in a tall tree. Will The Tweenies get doodles down the tree? Fizz flys up in the air but was unable to rescue Doodles.   Milo Flew in an airplane but ddin't get doodles.   And jake tried to fly in an air balloon. And ALMOST cought him... But did'nt!

videos.overview: Bella is being too bossy and the others dont want to play with her any more.

videos.overview: Milo pretends to be a magician and lets Jake play with it but then he made doodles disapear..Or did he?

videos.overview: Max lets Jake help dust the play house but then he makes everyone sneeze and sneeze, And ruins all the activities they do.

videos.overview: First song:Two fat gentle men   About:Bella has nothing to do. So she tries to help the others but she always ruin's everything.

videos.overview: Song:Whats in the Box   About:Milo imaginates in a box and doesnt let anyone in.   Story time:About a bear imaginated the moon.

videos.overview: Song:Will it sink or float   about:Max tries to get doodles in the bath tub no matter what.   The Tweenies have a contest what sinks or float.

videos.overview: Play:Once upon a time in the green kingdom lived KIng jake and princess fizz. Princess Fizz was playing outside and sir Milo suggested her to stay inside and told her about the dragon. But Princess Fizz didnt listen so Bella the Green Dragon so the Green Dragon took Fizz for her lunch. What Happens Next?

videos.overview: Bella Comes in and shows off to everyone about her new bracelet.   But then later on... She breaks them to pieces! Will they find all the beads to put back together?   Activity:Making a bracelet   Story:My uncle the tiger   Song:123 looking for the beads(US)

videos.overview: Milo and Fizz pretend to be 2 silly monkeys. Bella sais monkeys jump. But milo sais they climb around branches. Which one is right?

videos.title: Rockpool
videos.overview: Someone has stole Milo's shoe. And then they play a shoe matching game but then they all got lost! Is it Doodles,Max or one of the Tweenies?

videos.title: It Wasn't Me
videos.overview: Everybody has a special talent except little jake.   With Fizz with her dancing.   And Bella with her cooking.   And Milo with his funny jokes.   But Jake doesnt know what his talent really is. He is just too little to ahve a special talent.

videos.overview: *MAY CONTAIN SPOILERS FOR PEOPLE WHO MISSED THIS ONE*   Jake missunderstood what Max said about when night falls.   Jake thought with his silly little 3 year old mind that night really WILL fall! He told everyone! Fizz thought the planets will fall, Milo thought morning will crack and Bella thought all the planets and stars will hit there heads.

He blew down Bella hay house, Milo's stick house but couldn't blow down Fizz's new brick house!

Hey, but doodles noes is! Then Jake doesnt really wanna play any more... So he looks for Milo and they try to hide away from Fizz and Bella.

Then later The Tweenies were playing outside until they heard a Loud wackit! THey go inside then... It was a quitar! It must be the surprize in that case. Max spoiled it! They can't let judy find out!

videos.overview: The Tweenies are assigned to paint sheets with different colors. Max sais they all should be different from another. Bella has no color! Bella shares with Fizz but... It has to be a different color. How can they have different colors with 3 colors and 6 sheets? Milo said they should do stripes. Then Bella mest up and it made the color orange! Thats when The Tweenies popped an idea! Mix the colors all together! Some can make orange,Purple and red!

videos.title: Rainbow Magic
videos.overview: Plot: Fizz and Doodles see a rainbow in the garden, but by the time the others join them, it's gone. First Song: Peter Rabbit. Other Songs: Rainbows Are Magic (as sung by Fizz).

videos.title: Dragon
videos.overview: Plot: Brave Sir Milo takes on all the dragons hiding in the play room. First Song: If Your Happy And You Know It. Other Songs: It Must Be Great Being A Dragon. Messy Time: Fizz, Bella and Jake make a collage dragon. Story Time: There's No Such Thing As A Dragon.

videos.title: Modelling Clay
videos.overview: Jake was playing around until... He cut his finger! It bleed's. So The Tweenies will try anything to help Jake feel better! With a cut finger. All jake needs is a band aid. Where will they get one? Probally Max or Judy.

videos.title: Lost Frog
videos.overview: Plot: Jake finds a lost frog in the garden, so he, Fizz and Max take ""Norman"" back to the pond. First Song: Come On, Feel The Music. Other Songs: Five Little Speckled Frogs. Messy Time: Max makes a frog for Jake. Story Time: Picasso, The Green Tree Frog.

videos.title: Stuck Together
videos.overview: Plot: They all get stuck together! First Song: We All Clap Hands Together. Other Songs: If Your Happy And You Know It. Messy Time: Max makes an elephant jigsaw. Story Time: Lucy's Picture.

videos.title: Growing Bulbs
videos.overview: Plot: Jake brings in some bulbs his grandfather gave him, but he's not sure what he should do with them. First Song: Here We Go Looby Loo. Other Songs: I Planted My Bulbs. Telly Time: Plants that grow from bulbs. Messy Time: They each plant one of Jake's daffodils, and make a flower using tissue paper.

videos.title: Shiny Metal
videos.overview: Plot: Bella wants her magic wand to make everything in the playroom shine, so Max gives her the polish. First Song: If Your Happy And You Know It. Other Songs: Get In Line / Shine The Metal. Telly Time: Things made of metal. Story Time: King Midas.

videos.title: Big & Small
videos.overview: Plot: Jake's not too sure about the difference between big and small, so the others help him out. First Song: Mousy Brown. Other Songs: The Ant And The Elephant / We Think Mice Are Rather Nice. Telly Time: Things that are big and things that are small. Messy Time: Judy helps Fizz make a mouse, Milo draws an elephant and Jake draws an ant. Story Time: The Mouse And The Lion (by Fizz and Bella).

videos.title: Birthday
videos.overview: Plot: It's Fizz's birthday. First Song: Five Current Buns. Other Songs: There's Going To Be A Birthday Party / Happy Birthday. Telly Time: Making a birthday cake. Story Time: Bunny Cakes. Notes: Fizz is four.

videos.title: Sheets
videos.overview: Plot: Max is thinking about a holiday but can't decide where to go, so the Tweenies help him make up his mind. First Song: Five Little Men In A Flying Saucer. Other Songs: The Sun Has Got His Hat On / A Sailor Went To Sea. Story Time: Would They Love A Lion?

videos.title: Sand
videos.overview: Plot: Jake gets fed up when the others mess up his sand game, so Judy takes him and Milo to the beach. First Song: One Finger, One Thumb. Other Songs: Hunting Treasure. Notes: Milo, Jake and Judy go out to the beach, where Judy sets up a treasure hunt.

videos.title: Animal Dancers
videos.overview: Plot: Max shows the Tweenies a video of some animal skaters, which inspires them to dress up and put on a play. First Song: Old MacDonald. Telly Time: Peter rabbit on ice. Messy Time: They make various animal parts for their play. Notes: Milo is a duck, Jake's a frog, Bella's a swan and Fizz is a rabbit.

videos.title: Police
videos.overview: Plot: Bella finds a broach on the bus, so she, Milo and Max hand it into the police. First Song: I Went To School One Morning. Other Songs: Old Uncle Bill. Story Time: Skateboard Sarge.

videos.title: Printing
videos.overview: Plot: Judy can't decide what border to put up in the surprise area, so Fizz and the others make one for her. First Song: Put Your Finger In The Air. Telly Time: Printing. Messy Time: They use different shapes to print a fairy border.

videos.title: Rolling
videos.overview: Plot: Milo discovers that the fire engine has lost a wheel, so the others help him to look for a replacement. First Song: The Wheels On The Bus. Other Songs: The Fire Engine Wheels. Telly Time: Things that roll. Story Time: Foxy And Friends Go Racing.

videos.title: Rainy Day
videos.overview: Plot: Today they were planning to go to a farm, but as it's raining they have to stay in the playroom instead. First Song: I Went To School One Morning. Other Songs: The Pouring Rain. Telly Time: Rain. Messy Time: A ""Rainy Day"" picture. Story Time: Sonny's Wonderful Wellies.

videos.title: Cardboard Box
videos.overview: Plot: Max is about to throw out a lots of old cardboard boxes, but the Tweenies have a better idea. First Song: Sing A Song Of Sixpence. Other Songs: The Fun Never Stops With A Cardboard Box / The Cardboard Box Train. Story Time: Whatever Next!

videos.title: Caring For A Pet
videos.overview: Plot: Judy shows a video about how to look after a pet, but when they try it out on Doodles, Bella, Fizz and Milo get it a little wrong. First Song: If Your Happy And You Know It. Other Songs: I Want My Bone! Telly Time: How to look after cats, hamsters, fishes and dogs.

videos.title: Woolly Jumper
videos.overview: Plot: Milo has a new woolly jumper to show off, but things don't quite work out the way he had hoped. First Song: Here we Go Round The Mulberry Bush. Other Songs: Woolly Jumper. Telly Time: Knitting a woolly jumper. Messy Time: Milo, Fizz and Bella draw their ideal jumpers. Story Time: Barty's Scarf.

videos.title: Fairies
videos.overview: Plot: Bella wants to be a fairy, but somehow a curtain is not quite right for her wings. First Song: The Dressing Up Box. Other Songs: There Was A Princess Long Ago. Messy Time: Max helps Bella to make fairy wings and a wand. Story Time: Sleeping Beauty.

videos.title: Canal Boat
videos.overview: Plot: Jake wants to see the boats near Fizz's house, so Max takes them out to have a look. First Song: The Big Ship Sails On The Illy-Ally-O. Other Songs: Row Row Your Boat. Story Time: Snowy.

videos.title: Hot & Cold
videos.overview: Plot: Fizz and Jake like it hot, Bella and Milo like it cold - which is best? First Song: One Finger, One Thumb. Other Songs: Hot And Cold Don't Like Each Other / ibid. Telly Time: Things which are hot, and things which are cold. Messy Time: Bella makes a cloud, Fizz makes a sun. Story Time: Jake narrates the story of the traveller (Milo) in the hot sun (Fizz) and the cold wind (Bella).

videos.title: Hiccups
videos.overview: Plot: Milo has the hiccups - how did he get them, and, more importantly, how can he lose them? First Song: Come On, Feel The Music. Other Songs: Hiccup. Story Time: Oh No! Hilda's Got The Hiccups!

videos.title: Go Away, Bella
videos.overview: Plot: Bella doesn't know what to do with herself, so she tries to help the others with their games. However, her help is not very helpful. First Song: Two Fat Gentlemen. Other Songs: ibid. Messy Time: Fizz makes a variety of different hats.

videos.title: Meadow
videos.overview: Plot: Jake forgets what a meadow is, so Max goes to a farm to video one for him. First Song: One Man Went To Mow. Other Songs: Fuzzy Little Caterpillar. Telly Time: Max's trip to the meadow. Messy Time: Fizz and Bella make butterflies.

videos.title: Blow
videos.overview: Jake wants to know whether windmills are magic, or operated by the wind. So Jake, Fizz, Milo and Bella all take a magical trip inside their very own bubbles floating across the sky!

videos.title: I Can't Do It
videos.overview: Plot: Try, try and try again. First Song: Here We Go Looby Loo. Other Songs: It's Spongy Fun A Painting / I Won't Say That I Can't. Messy Time: Judy helps them with some printing.

videos.title: Leaves
videos.overview: Plot: Milo finds a leaf on his fleece, so he decides that he must be turning into a tree. First Song: If Your Happy And You Know It. Other Songs: All The Leaves That I've Seen. Story Time: An Acorn For Tea.

videos.title: Milo the Clown
videos.overview: Milo is concerned that he cannot join in with the circus game because he cannot be as funny as the other clowns. They can juggle and spin plates, but Milo cannot. Judy tells a story about a clown called Milo, convincing him that all he has to do is be himself. He performs and Bella plays the hooters.

videos.title: Litter
videos.overview: The Tweenies are taught what litter is and Jake invents a game of Litterbug. Playing pass the parcel is good fun but what a mess it makes - the only place for all that litter is in the bin!

videos.title: Disappearing Shoes
videos.overview: Strange goings on are afoot, as first Milo's shoe, then the dressing-up shoes, and then Max's gardening shoes go missing, but who is the mystery shoe snatcher?

videos.title: Get Down Doodles!
videos.overview: When Doodles gets stuck in a tree and the friends use pogo sticks, butterfly wings, aeroplanes, balloons and, finally, a ladder to get him down.

videos.title: Making Up
videos.overview: Bella and Milo fall out and won't talk to each other, so Jake and Fizz try to make the peace, but eventually it's Doodles who comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Water
videos.overview: Jake is playing in water and starts to imagine that the whole playroom is flooded.

videos.title: Feel It
videos.overview: The Tweenies play "who am I?" by wearing a blindfold and trying to guess who is in front of them just by touching. Milo loves his blindfold so much that he keeps it on all day, while Jake and Bella make a picture they can feel.

videos.title: Milking
videos.overview: The Tweenies are not convinced that milk comes from cows. They can't believe you squeeze those dangly things and then drink it. Judy visits a friend's farm one day and shows what happens.

videos.title: Space
videos.overview: The Tweenies make their own solar system and Jake constructs a rocket. Together Captain Jake and his intrepid crew then set off on a space voyage into the unknown, to boldly go where no Tweenie has gone before!

videos.title: Hospital Visit
videos.overview: Fizz is taken to hospital for a checkup after she falls off her bike and hurts her wrist. Meanwhile, Jake, Bella and Milo make their own pretend hospital as they wait for Fizz to return.

videos.title: Café
videos.overview: Bella makes café for the others to visit for tea, while Max shows them his visit to a real café.

videos.title: Cut Finger
videos.overview: Judy demonstrates how to dress a wound when Jake falls and cuts his finger. Then they all make finger puppets and perform a show.

videos.title: Milo's Scooter
videos.overview: Milo causes chaos as he tries to balance on his scooter, and Fizz, Jake and Bella play game of musical statues.

videos.title: It's a Circle
videos.overview: Milo shows the others how to draw a perfect circle. Then they go circle-spotting in the playroom and the garden. Jake feels left out because he is not as quick as the others, but when he becomes Dot Man he finds plenty of circles and puts them to good use rescuing Doodles.

videos.title: Oh, Oh, I'm Shrinking!
videos.overview: When the gang find a wiggly worm in the garden they wonder what it would be like to be teeny-weeny. Fizz's magic words transport the Tweenies to a giant world full of enormous flowers, buckets and snozzle monsters.

videos.title: Harvest
videos.overview: While Judy cuts the grass with a lawn mower, Max watches a combine harvester in the fields cutting wheat.

videos.title: Pancakes
videos.overview: Max tells Fizz his favourite food is pancakes, so the Tweenies make some for him, but then Doodles spoils the culinary surprise by eating the lot.
Jake tries to count the new buckets that he finds behind the surprise curtain, Bella and Milo try to help by building sandcastles and making flags.

videos.title: In & Out
videos.overview: Jake cannot co-ordinate himself when he dances the Hokey Cokey.

videos.title: What, No Books!
videos.overview: Fizz and Milo discover that all the story books have disappeared and wonder where they have gone. So instead of reading them a tale, Judy asks them to help her tell the story of Ananse and the Sky God.

videos.title: Camouflage
videos.overview: Bella introduces her new pet, Sally the stick insect, and the gang see other animals that use colours and patterns for hiding. Meanwhile Milo finds a clever way to hide in the garden so that the others can't find him.

videos.title: Train Journey
videos.overview: Max's car has broken down so he decides to get the train. Having bought his ticket, found a seat and bought a drink he falls asleep and misses his stop. He gets off at the next stop and misses the next train back. He arrives very late at the playgroup and tells the Tweenies all that has happened.

videos.title: Frosty Day
videos.overview: After singing Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush on a cold and frosty morning, the Tweenies are disappointed to find that all the snow and ice in the garden has melted. Max helps them to make it a frosty day inside by showing them how to make paper ice patterns and icicles. Finally, the Tweenies can step outside into the magical world of Jack Frost.

videos.title: Pretend Friend
videos.overview: Jake introduces his new invisible friend called Douglas. Meanwhile Fizz and Bella are practising a new dance – Tweenie Beat, but Jake cannot seem to learn it. Perhaps Douglas can help?

videos.title: Bridges
videos.overview: Max takes Fizz and Jake for a boat trip on the River Thames. Later Judy, Milo and Bella see a footbridge in the country.

videos.title: The Bracelet
videos.overview: Bella has a new bracelet and boasts about it. Fizz is jealous, and she makes her own bracelet from pasta. Then Bella breaks her bracelet when showing off. The Tweenies all try to look for the missing beads.

videos.title: Building Blocks
videos.overview: Piles of books arrive in the playroom and the Tweenies use them to build tall towers instead of reading them.

videos.title: Jake's Ill
videos.overview: Jake looks through his box of games to recall fond memories while he recovers from a bout of chicken pox.

videos.title: The Fallen Star
videos.overview: Everybody is excited as the Christmas decorations go up in the playgroup, and when Fizz finds a fallen star in the garden, she wonders whether it fell from the sky or off the tinsel.

videos.title: The Christmas Fairy
videos.overview: Max brings in the Christmas tree ready to be decorated and Bella decides to be the Christmas fairy but has problems climbing up.

videos.title: Santa's Little Helper
videos.overview: Dotman and Alf Elf go to the North Pole to find out how Santa wraps all the presents and copes in an emergency.

videos.title: The Nativity
videos.overview: The gang performs its own version of the Nativity play.

videos.title: Christmas Eve
videos.overview: The Tweenies hope for a visit from Father Christmas. If their dreams come true they will be taken on the trip of a lifetime on Santa's sleigh and see the children of all the world.

videos.title: Corner Shop
videos.overview: The Tweenies are having a picnic but Judy has forgotten a few items so she pops out to the corner shop. She gets a bit carried away and forgets what she went for. Eventually the picnic is ready and they all tuck in.

videos.title: Can't Go There
videos.overview: Fizz and her friends cannot go in the garden or on the computer. They cannot go anywhere! They decide on a magical flying carpet ride.

videos.title: Signs
videos.overview: Fizz discovers a special picture box in her toybox – it is a sign. The Tweenies discover that signs tell you all sorts of things – like where to find the post office or the toilet. Max makes some special signs which take the Tweenies on a treasure hunt.

videos.title: Sleep-over
videos.overview: Bella is having a sleep-over at Fizz's house. Fizz gets annoyed with Bella coming in and disrupting her very tidy bedroom. However, once Fizz has calmed down a bit, they have a laugh about some of the silly things the Tweenies have done at playgroup.

videos.title: Supermarket
videos.overview: Max goes shopping after learning a special remembering song to make sure that he doesn't forget what to buy.

videos.title: Fast & Slow
videos.overview: Jake's magic trick goes wrong, resulting in the disappearance of Doodles.

videos.title: Aladdin
videos.overview: The Aladdin legend is acted out by the Tweenies.

videos.title: Milo's Orange
videos.overview: Orange proves to be a difficult word to rhyme.

videos.title: Oodles of Doodles
videos.overview: Doodles spends time alone.

videos.title: Pirates
videos.overview: The Tweenies dress up like pirates and search for buried treasure.

videos.title: Sneezing
videos.overview: Dusting causes sneezing.

videos.title: Practical Jokes
videos.overview: The kids play practical jokes on each other.

videos.title: A Story from India
videos.overview: A story from India enthralls the Tweenies.

videos.title: The Wall
videos.overview: The kids build a house.

videos.title: Judy's Guitar
videos.overview: Judy plays her guitar for the Tweenies.

videos.title: Invitations
videos.overview: The Tweenies stage their own pantomime and make invitations for their parents.

videos.title: Cold Wilson
videos.overview: Milo is desperate to make a snowman, but there is so little snow. The answer is to make a little snowman called Cold Wilson and bring him inside to keep him warm.

videos.title: Wishes
videos.overview: Fizz wishes her pals were different by using Doodles' wishbone. Bella isn't bossy, Milo is quiet and Jake is 4 years old and can do things that he couldn't do before.

videos.title: Getting Ready
videos.overview: The Tweenies get ready for their show, but what is the story of Jack and the Beans that talk?

videos.title: Jake and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: The Tweenies perform a panto called Jake and the Beanstalk.

videos.title: Penelope Pink
videos.overview: Fizz meets her dream toy, Penelope Pink the Pop Princess; but Penelope is not as sweet as she looks.

videos.title: Highly Strung
videos.overview: Jake meets a highly-strung string puppet called Jangles and helps give him the confidence to perform.

videos.title: Little Blue Plane
videos.overview: Milo does not like playing with baby toys like plastic planes - he prefers his rocket just like Commander Cosmos' - until he meets a magical, little blue plane called Joffi in the Enchanted Toyshop.

videos.title: Mouse Hole Theatre
videos.overview: Bella meets a troupe of theatrical mice in need of a director.

videos.title: Christmas Morning
videos.overview: The Enchanted Toyshop wakes up to some surprises on Christmas Day.

videos.title: Copycats
videos.overview: When Doodles starts copying Bella, the Tweenies decide to play a "copying" game. They act out the story of Chicken Licken and end up copying Doodles.

videos.title: It's Going Round & Round
videos.overview: When Milo plays with his yo-yo everyone wants to have a go too, but only Fizz has the knack.

videos.title: Up the Mountain
videos.overview: Judy visits Mount Snowdon in search of "something wonderful".

videos.title: Someone Tell Bella
videos.overview: Bella is bossy and telling the others they are going into the jungle after news time they tell her she kept thinking was about her self she gets upset because she thinks they don't like her anymore.

videos.title: The King with Dirty Feet
videos.overview: Milo comes in from the garden and leaves muddy footprints on the floor. While the mud is drying, Judy tells the Tweenies a story about the King With Dirty Feet. The Tweenies act it out in the playroom with a special river and beautiful patchwork carpet.

videos.title: I Just Can't Wait
videos.overview: Judy brings in parcels of costumes for Cleo's fancy dress party, but the Tweenies have to wait before they are allowed to open them. Milo finds it very hard to wait and Bella tells him to listen to his conscience. Milo does wait, and the Tweenies open their costumes together and have fun playing in them.

videos.title: Pulling
videos.overview: The Tweenies play some pulling games when Jake finds a rope in the garden.

videos.title: Octopus
videos.overview: Judy shows the Tweenies a video about an octopus and the Tweenies decide to dress up as sea creatures. They use odds and ends from the playroom and make wonderful costumes. The Tweenies sing a song about Olive the octopus, and Judy reads then a story called "Commotion in the Ocean".

videos.title: Jake's Dolly
videos.overview: Jake takes his dolly to Milo's house for a sleepover, but Milo thinks that Jake's dolly is silly.

videos.title: Cheeky Monkey
videos.overview: After imitating monkeys, the friends debate whether monkeys swing or bounce.

videos.title: Chopsticks
videos.overview: Fizz is put to the test when she boasts about how good she is at eating with chopsticks.

videos.title: Chinese New Year
videos.overview: Judy shows the Tweenies a video about Chinese New Year featuring the Lion Dance. The Tweenies find things around the playroom to make their own lion and they all do the Lion dance in the garden, which is decorated with Chinese lanterns. Judy reads the story of The Lion Dance.

videos.title: Going Underground
videos.overview: Judy finds her way around the London Underground.

videos.title: When I'm Older
videos.overview: The Tweenies talk about what they would like to be when they are older, then dress up and surprise Max.

videos.title: My Body
videos.overview: Bella falls over and hurts her ankle, and decides to sit down and rest. Then the Tweenies make cutouts of Jake and Bella and color them in, and they sing Heads, Shoulders, Knees and Toes.

videos.title: Flower Shop
videos.overview: Some flowers are delivered for Judy, so the foursome make their own, and Bella has a flower shop.

videos.title: Scrap Metal
videos.overview: Max searches for scrap metal for Milo.

videos.title: Fizz is Sucking Her Thumb
videos.overview: Fizz pretends to be a baby and sucks her thumb and plays in her cot, but then she cannot join in activities with the others.

videos.title: Knights
videos.overview: Fizz produces a model knight on a horse and the Tweenies learn about knights and chivalry. They make shields and lances and prepare for a tournament. Doodles feels left out and dreams that he is a good knight who fights the baddies and rescues the princess. After his dream, he joins in the tournament – and wins!

videos.title: Postman
videos.overview: The chums dream about being flying postmen, then make cards to post to each other in their cardboard postbox.

videos.title: This is Art
videos.overview: The Tweenies see an art gallery on television and decide to make a gallery of their own. Fizz's paintings end in disaster, but Max saves the day by putting them in a modern art gallery.

videos.title: Mosaic
videos.overview: Judy is making a mosaic from tiny tiles and shows the Tweenies a video of wall and floor mosaics. Judy helps them make mosaics for the playroom floor. Many shiny things in the garden go missing, including some of Judy's mosaic tiles, and Max discovers all the lost items in a magpie's nest in the tree.

videos.title: Thanks Milo
videos.overview: Milo tries to be good all day. He helps Fizz and Bella decorate their chairs, plays Dot Man with Jake, helps Judy finish her song and finds Doodles' missing bone. He even dresses up as a princess so that the Tweenies can sing Three Princesses. Everyone says thanks to Milo.

videos.title: Tigers
videos.overview: Judy gives Max a pair of tiger slippers, which inspires the Tweenies to watch a video, play tiger games and sing Tiger Feet.

videos.title: Useless
videos.overview: Doodles tries to play with the others, but he does not know how to. He gets upset and hides in the playhouse. Fizz wonders if dogs are useless, so Judy shows a video about helpful dogs. The Tweenies make medals for Doodles to show how useful he is and he cheers up.

videos.title: My Special Talent
videos.overview: Jake feels that the others are all good at something. Fizz is good at dancing, Bella can cook, Milo tells great jokes and Doodles can smell things. Then Jake realizes that he does have a special talent – he is the best audience!

videos.title: Telling Tales
videos.overview: Fizz tells tales about the others and soon Jake and Milo are not talking to Bella. Will Max's story help them to make friends again?

videos.title: Snakerooni
videos.overview: Fizz brings a pet snake to show the others and Milo admits he is scared, so Fizz and Max help Milo to overcome his fear of snakes.

videos.title: Jake's Tantrum
videos.overview: Jake has a terrible tantrum when he cannot tie his shoelaces, then dreams that he is superhero Dot Man. But later he realizes that he will learn when he is older.

videos.title: Funny Bella
videos.overview: Bella spends the day trying to make others laugh. They are delighted with this new, funny Bella, but wonder why she is acting like this. She explains she is being funny to make them like her more, but the Tweenies reassure her that they like her however she behaves.

videos.title: Man in the Moon
videos.overview: Max tells Jake about the Man in the Moon, and Jake thinks something is wrong when he sees the moon still out in the morning sky. He tries to find out more about the Man in the Moon and imagines meeting him and helping him put the moon away.

videos.title: Glass Blowing
videos.overview: A crystal present poses problems for Max when he has a smashing time with glass.

videos.title: Bananas
videos.overview: Doodles shows a surprising liking for Jake's bananas and one by one he takes them all away. Jake is upset because bananas are his favorite food. The Tweenies take Jake on a banana hunt, but they do not find any – until Doodles provides another surprise.

videos.title: Blues
videos.overview: Fizz isn't her normal, happy self. The Tweenies provide a happy song, some jokes and even a visit to Dr. Bella, but nothing makes her feel better until Max finally finds a way to cure her blues.

videos.title: Jake's Snuggly
videos.overview: Bella accidentally uses Jake's comfort blanket as a duster. Judy puts it in the washing machine, but it shrinks.

videos.title: Scribbling
videos.overview: Milo accidentally makes a pen mark on the door, but then it comes to life as scribble-boy and teases him about what he has done. How can Milo get rid of his scribble? How will he keep his terrible secret from the others? And what will Judy say?

videos.title: Self Portraits
videos.overview: The pals paint each other's portraits, Bella is unhappy with hers. But her friends manage to cheer her up.

videos.title: Again
videos.overview: Fizz tries the others' patience when she repeats her actions over and over again.

videos.title: Pottery Present
videos.overview: Max visits a pottery to get a present for someone very special.

videos.title: Jumping
videos.overview: When Doodles is envious of another dog's jumping abilities, Fizz tries to teach him how to jump.

videos.title: Stained Glass
videos.overview: Judy visits a stained glass museum in search of inspiration for a new front-door window.

videos.title: Favourite Songs
videos.overview: Jake cannot decide which song is his favorite when the Tweenies decide to do their own version of Top of the Pops.

videos.title: Swim
videos.overview: Milo reveals that he can't swim and is taken on an underwater adventure.

videos.title: Sssh!
videos.overview: When Fizz hears a squeaking noise, she is convinced a mouse is near, so the friends go on a mouse hunt.

videos.title: Night's Falling
videos.overview: Jake and the others get confused about what happens when night falls.

videos.title: Green
videos.overview: The Tweenies hunt for green things to make a green dragon. They visit green land and turn Bella into a dragon.

videos.title: It's Mine
videos.overview: A catastrophe leads Doodles to claim everything is his – even the moon.

videos.title: Butterfly
videos.overview: Jake finds out what "having butterflies in your stomach" really means.

videos.title: School Show
videos.overview: Max sees a chance for stardom when he helps out at a school show.

videos.title: Grumpy Max
videos.overview: Max tackles a DIY shelf kit – or is it his grumpy brother?

videos.title: No
videos.overview: The Tweenies play the yes/no game. When no-one can guess what Jake has thought of, they think he's cheating. Jake sulks until Doodles helps him.

videos.title: Dog's Home
videos.overview: Max pays a visit to Battersea Dogs' Home in south London to help a friend to find her dog.

videos.title: Bees
videos.overview: A bee flies into the playroom and Max shows the Tweenies how to make bumblebees. When Fizz takes them into the garden, something surprising happens.

videos.title: Digger
videos.overview: Jake uses his new digger to look for treasure in the garden. Bella and Fizz decide to be pirate sisters, and bury a treasure box full of jewels in the sandpit to surprise Jake. But when Jake digs up the box and the treasure is missing, everyone is surprised! Where has it gone?

videos.title: Big Box
videos.overview: Jake finds Milo playing in a big cardboard box. Milo is pretending that it is a submarine and then an airplane. He stays in the box for story time while the others describe the pictures to him. Then they all join him in the box and pretend that it is a runaway train!

videos.title: Slug
videos.overview: Fizz goes to the toilet, and comes across a slug. Bella is the only one who likes it, so she tries to convince the others that slugs are great.

videos.title: Ciao Bella
videos.overview: When Bella receives a postcard from her friends in Venice, she teaches everyone to say 'ciao'. They watch a video about Venice, make Italian food and ride in gondolas.

videos.title: Jake's Been Sick
videos.overview: Max asks Jake to put away some cooking apples for him, but he decides to eat one (without knowing it is a cooking apple). He starts to feel very ill and is eventually sick. Fizz and Milo are not very sympathetic, but Nurse Bella is.

videos.title: Restaurant
videos.overview: Max helps out at a restaurant and demonstrates how to make pizza.

videos.title: Sardines
videos.overview: Max suggests that the friends play a game called sardines. Milo hides first in the cupboard followed by Bella, Fizz, Jake and Doodles. Max arrives and tells them a story, but they still do not know how the game ends!

videos.title: No Shoes
videos.overview: Max has mopped the floor so the Tweenies have to remove their muddy boots before they can play indoors, but then somebody steals them.

videos.title: Pinching
videos.overview: The Tweenies pinch each other and Judy talks to find out why they done it 1st Milo pinched Bella because he was doing a jigsaw puzzle so Bella took one of the pieces 2nd Bella Fizz and Jake make their own jigsaw puzzles when Fizz offers to help Bella she pinches Fizz 3rd Jake wants to play hide and seek but Fizz doesn't want to so she pinches Jake 4th when Milo upsets Jake over a story he pinches Milo when Judy tells them it's wrong to pinch someone, including friends.

videos.title: Watermill
videos.overview: Max visits a watermill where he grinds his own wheat, makes his own flour, bakes bread and eats it.

videos.title: Pajama Time
videos.overview: The Tweenies have been wearing pajamas Doodles get Fizz muddy so she puts her pajamas on Bella's pants rip so she puts her pajamas on Milo had his pajamas on but Jake doesn't so Milo gets him some dressing up pajamas.

videos.title: Keep Out
videos.overview: Milo's friends get their own back when he builds a castle in the garden and tells them to keep out. They build a house in the playroom and tell him to keep out.

videos.title: Careful, Don't Be Clumsy
videos.overview: Milo learns to take his time, to stop being so clumsy.

videos.title: A Walk in the Woods
videos.overview: While out for a walk in the woods, Max joins a teddy bears' picnic.

videos.title: Max's Stiff Neck
videos.overview: The Tweenies pretend to have stiff bodies when Max suffers from a stiff neck.

videos.title: I Hate It
videos.overview: After throwing a tantrum because she can't have a picnic, Fizz dreams she is unpopular and decides to improve her behavior.

videos.title: Leaky Beanbag
videos.overview: Jake dreams that his beanbag has leaked all over the playroom.

videos.title: Blade of Grass
videos.overview: Jake takes a closer look at the grass in the garden, while Fizz brings her lucky charm bracelet to playgroup.

videos.title: Neighbours
videos.overview: Bella and Jake have a problem with very noisy neighbors, but what can they do about it?

videos.title: Videotape
videos.overview: Fizz is sad when her favorite video gets damaged.

videos.title: Coaches & Carriages
videos.overview: Max takes a ride on a stagecoach when he visits a coach museum.

videos.title: Arrows
videos.overview: When the Tweenies play at being Robin Hood and his Merry Men, the garden becomes a magical forest.

videos.title: Desert
videos.overview: Judy's desert story takes the Tweenies on an adventure in search of buried treasure.

videos.title: Donkey Village
videos.overview: Judy visits a special village for donkeys.

videos.title: No Words
videos.overview: Bella uses the pictures on a willow-pattern plate to help tell a story.

videos.title: Pigs
videos.overview: Max tells the classic story of the three little pigs and the big bad wolf. Meanwhile Jake and Doodles start to feel very greedy.

videos.title: Go to Sleep Fizz
videos.overview: Fizz finds it difficult to get to sleep. What will make her go to sleep?

videos.title: Milo's Rocket
videos.overview: Milo leads a mission to Mars, assisted by Jupiter Jake and Daring Dog Doodles.

videos.title: Cut
videos.overview: Max uses his video camera to film a day in the life of the Tweenies – but nothing goes the way he planned.

videos.title: Steam Train
videos.overview: Max visits a steam railway.

videos.title: Stripes
videos.overview: The Tweenies are making patterned wrapping paper. Bella tells Jake to draw stripes, but Jake does not know what stripes are. Doodles introduces him to a zebra and they visit the land of stripes, where everything is stripy, so Jake learns how to paint his stripy wrapping paper.

videos.title: Car Journey
videos.overview: Jake has fun in the car with his mom whilst stuck in a traffic jam. Meanwhile, the same cannot be said for the rest of the gang. Bella, Fizz and Milo are all bored at playgroup without Jake.

videos.title: Milo's Sweets
videos.overview: Milo brings in a big bag of pick-and-mix sweets, but he will not share them with the other Tweenies. He refuses to have melon with them, and then eats so many sweets he feels sick. He decides to give away his last three sweets to the others and eat melon instead!

videos.title: All at Sea
videos.overview: Judy is on holiday in Scotland, bobbing up and down in a boat.

videos.title: Spots
videos.overview: Jake tries to find out where the spots on the new playroom curtains have gone. The others make spotty masks and sing a spotty song. Max explains the spotty curtain mystery.

videos.title: Ants
videos.overview: When Milo finds ants in the kitchen he and Fizz use the computer to learn all about them. They use their magnifying glasses to look at them closely and the Tweenies imagine they are in an anthill dancing with the ants. Bella catches the ants in a jam jar and the Tweenies release them in the garden - much to Judy's relief!

videos.title: Highlands & Islands
videos.overview: Judy learns Scottish dancing in a castle and goes in search of fluffy rabbits.

videos.title: Snow
videos.overview: The Tweenies want it to snow and play snowy games inside, then they wish for it and it really does snow in the garden.

videos.title: What Makes Winter?
videos.overview: It's a frosty day and the Tweenies learn about winter. They make a big winter collage from things they collect in the garden, while they sing What Makes Winter. Judy reads them a story called Ridiculous, by Michael Coleman, about a tortoise who wants to explore winter rather than hibernate.

videos.title: Bats
videos.overview: The friends learn all about bats and Max invents a game about them.

videos.title: King of the Castle
videos.overview: Max makes a castle in the garden, with Doodles as the dragon.

videos.title: Decorating
videos.overview: The Tweenies help Judy and Max decorate the playroom then agree it looked better before.

videos.title: Say Cheese
videos.overview: Judy turns her hand to cheese-making on a trip to Cheddar Gorge.

videos.title: Oh, I Forgot!
videos.overview: A visit from Max's sister Polly leads to confusion for both of them.

videos.title: Crocodile Tears
videos.overview: Bella and Fizz learn about crocodiles, while Jake has a bad case of crocodile tears.

videos.title: Up & Away
videos.overview: Max flies in a hot-air balloon.

videos.title: Wings
videos.overview: Fizz dress up as a butterfly, Bella puts on her fairy princess costume, and Milo pretends to be an eagle – but Jake cannot find an outfit with wings on. The others pretend to fly in the garden, so Jake dresses as Dotman to join in their game. Max buys them all new costumes with wings on, but they have done enough flying for one day.

videos.title: Checks
videos.overview: Bella brings her check quilt into the playgroup and shows the others how to make check patterns. Max tiles the kitchen floor with a check pattern, Fizz makes a check painting and Milo and Jake play a game with check tiles.

videos.title: Don't Go Max
videos.overview: The Tweenies think that Max and Doodles are going to leave them forever.

videos.title: Hanukkah
videos.overview: The friends learn about Hanukkah, the Jewish festival of lights, and decide to hold their own Hanukkah party. They watch a video, make potato latkes, play dreidl, make a menorah, hear the story of Hanukkah and open presents.

videos.title: Muddle Day
videos.overview: When Milo puts his coat on back to front, the Tweenies decide to do everything muddled up. They play muddled up hide-and-seek, do a muddled up painting and muddle up the playroom.

videos.title: Jake's Mountain
videos.overview: Judy visits a power station in the middle of a Scottish mountain.

videos.title: Cranes
videos.overview: Max finds the other Tweenies useful when they become cranes for the day.

videos.title: What's in the Box?
videos.overview: Milo's box contains an amazing secret, and the others cannot believe what is inside.

videos.title: White Christmas
videos.overview: Jake is sick in bed on Christmas Day, so his friends come to visit to make him feel better.

videos.title: Searching for Santa
videos.overview: Max has some presents for Santa but first he has to find him.

videos.title: Slippery Slopes
videos.overview: Max tries his hand at skiing but finds that it is not as easy as he thought.

videos.title: The Name Game
videos.overview: Bella has found out that her name means beautiful and the other Tweenies use the computer to find out the origins of their names.

videos.title: New Arrival
videos.overview: Judy introduces a new dog to the group but the friends have mixed emotions about her. She's great fun, but very bouncy. Fizz and Milo think she is lovely, but Jake is frightened of her and is worried that she might be staying. Is Jake right to be frightened?

videos.title: Big Brave Jake
videos.overview: Jake is not happy because the new dog, Izzles, is bouncy and keeps jumping up at him. Doodles is not happy because he is not getting as much attention anymore. Milo and Fizz told Jake that he does not have to be big to be brave, and he learns to control the boisterous new pet.

videos.title: Doodles is Strange
videos.overview: Doodles is jealous of the new dog, Izzles, and is so naughty that Max punishes him. The Tweenies make collages of the two dogs, and Doodles learns to make friends with the newcomer.

videos.title: Honest Doodles
videos.overview: Doodles teaches Izzles much, but allows Izzles to take the blame for his mistakes. In the end, Doodles learns to be honest, and tells the Tweenies that he has behaved badly.

videos.title: Coming or Going
videos.overview: Max and Judy have to make a decision about Izzles' future with the Tweenies. Doodles has a word with her and Izzles starts to behave. The Tweenies are delighted that Izzles can stay now she is behaving herself.

videos.title: Whales
videos.overview: Jake is curious about whales. He wants to know how big a blue whale really is, and tries to find out.

videos.title: Tom Thumb
videos.overview: The Tweenies imagine they shrink to Tom Thumb's size and explore the playroom. They discover that it is frightening being small.

videos.title: Car Boot Sale
videos.overview: Max takes some of his belongings to a car-boot sale – but will he manage to sell anything?

videos.title: Light & Heavy
videos.overview: It's up and down day for the Tweenies when Max's surprise does not work out as planned.

videos.title: What a Day!
videos.overview: Every time the Tweenies get changed to go outside the weather changes. They put on their sun hats and it starts to rain, they dress up for the rain and it gets windy and when they get out into the garden, it starts to thunder.

videos.title: Percussion
videos.overview: The friends learn all about percussion instruments and Milo wants to play them all.

videos.title: Strings
videos.overview: The friends learn all about stringed instruments and make music pictures.

videos.title: Brass
videos.overview: The friends learn all about brass instruments, play around, and Bella and the Brass Notes perform their latest hit.

videos.title: Woodwind
videos.overview: The friends learn all about woodwind instruments. While Judy makes music, all Max can produce is a terrible noise!

videos.title: Orchestra
videos.overview: Max is invited to play with an orchestra, and it all goes with a bang.

videos.title: Blaming the Wrong Person
videos.overview: Fizz finds her clay dinosaur toy missing, and accuses Milo of taking it.

videos.title: The Five Wishes
videos.overview: Jake's wishes all come true, but for some reason they don't make him happy. What can possibly be wrong?

videos.title: Max & Manx
videos.overview: Max goes fishing with his friend Brian on the Isle of Man. Unfortunately, Max does not turn out to be a great fisherman. After seeing how herrings are turned into kippers, Max meets some Manx cats.

videos.title: Handyman Milo
videos.overview: Milo fancies himself as a bit of a handyman. He tries to mend Max's clock but breaks it instead. Will Max be cross with him?

videos.title: Lost Your Smile?
videos.overview: Bella wants someone to help her find her smile again. Perhaps the day's story "Where's Your Smile Crocodile?" will help.

videos.title: Looking for Fairies
videos.overview: Max goes to the Isle of Man in search of fairies. On the way, he takes a walk in the woods, and travels by horse tram and steam train. But will he find the fairies?

videos.title: Playing Together
videos.overview: The Tweenies refuse to play together so they play on their own Milo plays snap Bella reads a book Fizz has a tea party and Jake plays with a beach ball Max reads a story called it's my turn then they all be friends again.

videos.title: The Present
videos.overview: Bella gives Fizz a stick as a present, and Fizz finds out just how useful it can be.

videos.title: Circus
videos.overview: Max visits the circus, finds out about life there and meets some talented friends.

videos.title: I Want One If Bella Wants One
videos.overview: Fizz decides to be a copycat and copies Bella in everything she does.

videos.title: Champions!
videos.overview: The Tweenies discover what their skills are and what they are champions at. Everyone is good at something.

videos.title: Oh, My Hair!
videos.overview: Fizz has a hair-raising day as she tries to decide whether long or short hair is best.

videos.title: Fizz's Surprise
videos.overview: Fizz excitedly tells everybody that her mother is about to have a baby, and the baby is expected that day. Every time the phone rings, she thinks it will be her daddy with the news.

videos.title: Welcome Baby
videos.overview: Fizz celebrates the birth of her baby brother and makes him a card, Jake and Bella play mommies and daddies, while Milo has a surprise in store for Doodles – a new kennel.

videos.title: Feeling Let Down
videos.overview: Fizz is fed up with her new baby brother. She is tired and in a bad mood. Bella and Jake make a care for their baby doll.

videos.title: Prickly Fizz
videos.overview: Milo discovers a hedgehog in the garden. Fizz is still in a bad mood because the arrival of her baby brother has made her feel left out at home, so Max asks her to care for the hedgehog.

videos.title: Big Sister
videos.overview: Fizz enjoys looking after the hedgehog, and when they have to let it go, she is happy to play with the baby dolly.

videos.title: Who Can Help?
videos.overview: When Milo and Jake play firemen their fire truck keeps breaking they ask Bella to fix it but she tapes it up they ask Fizz she says talk to it nicely they boys end up telling Judy and she fixes it.

videos.title: In Between
videos.overview: Jake finds out the meaning of "in between", with the help of Doodles.

videos.title: One to Win
videos.overview: Max and Judy have a race against each other, with Max driving a modern car and Judy driving an old-fashioned one. It is obvious who will win - or is it?

videos.title: It's the Thought That Counts
videos.overview: Bella discovers that it is Judy's birthday, and the Tweenies decide to secretly bake her a cake, but Max is trying to fix the washing machine at the same time and the cake goes wrong. Max explains to Bella that it is the thought that counts.

videos.title: Dancing Feet
videos.overview: The Tweenies watch different types of dancing on the computer and put on a show. Fizz loves the Indian dancing, while Milo does Hungarian dancing and Bella does flamenco. Jake feels left out because he thinks he cannot dance properly, but he finds that he has got a special talent for Greek dancing.

videos.title: Let's Be Each Other
videos.overview: The Tweenies decide it would be great fun to be each other, so they swap clothes and there toys. Bella pretends to be Milo she gets the scooter Milo pretends to be Fizz he likes pink and he gets the tutu Fizz is Jake she gets the spotty cape and Jake is Bella making him the oldest Doodles is Izzles being naughty and Izzles is Judy and telling them all what to do.

videos.title: Milo Wants to Know
videos.overview: Judy asks a long list of questions when she visits the Science Museum.

videos.title: Goats & Trolls
videos.overview: The Tweenies learn about goats and play with a pretend troll called Bogsnort.

videos.title: Kangaroos
videos.overview: Jake dresses up as a kangaroo with help from Judy, and dances a kangaroo can-can with the others. Bouncing around is a lot of fun.

videos.title: Why Do People Do Bad Things?
videos.overview: The Tweenies are horrified to learn that somebody kicked Doodles while he was on a walk. Bella also reveals that some of her neighbors have been rude to new neighbors because of the color of their skin.

videos.title: Being Really Old
videos.overview: Bella calls Milo, Fizz and Jake on her meeting table. They are worried about Max's old age, so they decide to help him – with disastrous consequences.

videos.title: The Giant's Breakfast
videos.overview: The Tweenies make breakfast for a giant, and Dot Man and Oval Man go on an adventure.

videos.title: Which Way to Turn?
videos.overview: Bella makes a magical telescope which transports the Tweenies to a magical blue forest, where they all lose each other!

videos.title: Moving House
videos.overview: Max helps a family move to a new house.

videos.title: Brushes
videos.overview: Jake and Fizz decide to brush the dogs in exchange for some biscuits, but when the dogs do not get their biscuits they come up with a plan to get their own back.

videos.title: Imaginary Pet
videos.overview: Fizz is upset that she does not have a pony, so Jake suggests that she pretends she has one.

videos.title: Off to the Sun
videos.overview: It is holiday time for Max and he is up, up and away!

videos.title: Happy Holiday
videos.overview: Max has fun on holiday in sunny Tenerife, visiting an aquapark, an eagle park and Loro Parque.

videos.title: What Makes Spring?
videos.overview: The Tweenies look for signs of spring in the garden and make a spring collage.
